episode_title: 今日雙語精華：Nvidia、移民與一位「蟑螂」領袖的奇遇！
episode_summary: 本集帶你直擊全球熱點！Nvidia 陷入政治風暴，川普介入疑雲重重；一位移民在美西雅圖的命運大轉折；還有印度領袖因「蟑螂」稱號被禁飛的荒謬劇。保證讓你聽得津津有味！

selected_links.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
Kilmar Ábrego García leaving US for Spain, ending Trump deportation battle
Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight

segments.zh: 哈囉！各位聽眾朋友，歡迎收聽二零二六年十一月二十五日的每日五分鐘雙語精華。
segments.en: Hello everyone! Welcome to today's five-minute bilingual highlights on November twenty-fifth, two thousand twenty-six.

segments.zh: 我是你們風趣的雙語主持人，今天我們要聊聊 Reddit 上最熱門、最引人入勝的話題。
segments.en: I'm your fun bilingual host, and today we're diving into Reddit's hottest and most captivating topics.

segments.zh: 準備好探索 Nvidia 的風暴、移民命運轉折，還有那位被稱作「蟑螂」的印度領袖嗎？
segments.en: Ready to explore Nvidia's storm, an immigrant's fate, and the Indian leader dubbed 'cockroach'?

segments.zh: 首先，我們來看看科技巨頭 Nvidia 的麻煩事，股價跌了七個百分點呢！
segments.en: First up, let's talk about tech giant Nvidia's recent troubles; their stock price actually dropped seven percent!

segments.zh: 美國司法部長被追問關於前總統川普介入黃先生復職的調查，但他卻閃爍其詞。
segments.en: The US Attorney General dodged questions about former President Trump's involvement in Mr. Huang's reinstatement.

segments.zh: 這讓大家都在猜，到底川普在 Nvidia 的高層人事變動中扮演了什麼角色？
segments.en: Everyone's wondering what role Trump played in Nvidia's executive personnel changes.

segments.zh: Reddit 網友們當然沒放過這個機會，有人說：「難道川普現在也想當科技大亨了嗎？」
segments.en: Reddit users, of course, seized the opportunity; one joked, 'Is Trump trying to be a tech mogul now?'

segments.zh: 還有人開玩笑說：「黃先生的職位，大概是史上最昂貴的『實習生』吧！」
segments.en: Another quipped, 'Mr. Huang's position must be the most expensive 'internship' in history!'

segments.zh: 這場調查讓 Nvidia 股價受到衝擊，也讓市場對其未來發展充滿不確定性。
segments.en: This investigation has hit Nvidia's stock and created market uncertainty about its future.

segments.zh: 這也再次證明，政治和商業總是難分難捨啊！
segments.en: It just goes to show you, politics and business are always intertwined!

segments.zh: 接下來，我們把目光轉向一位名叫基爾馬·阿布雷戈·加西亞的移民故事。
segments.en: Next, let's turn our attention to the story of an immigrant named Kilmar Ábrego García.

segments.zh: 他與美國政府的驅逐出境戰役，在川普的移民政策下曾引發巨大爭議。
segments.en: His deportation battle with the US government became a flashpoint under Trump's immigration policies.

segments.zh: 最新消息是，他將離開美國前往西班牙，這也代表他長期的抗爭終於畫下句點。
segments.en: The latest news is he's leaving the US for Spain, marking the end of his long struggle.

segments.zh: Reddit 上有網友感嘆：「這不是勝利，這是悲哀的妥協。」
segments.en: A Reddit user lamented, 'This isn't a victory; it's a sad compromise.'

segments.zh: 也有人說：「至少他能去一個真正歡迎他的地方。」
segments.en: Others commented, 'At least he's going somewhere he'll truly be welcomed.'

segments.zh: 這段經歷凸顯了許多移民在美國所面臨的困境與掙扎。
segments.en: This experience highlights the difficulties and struggles many immigrants face in the US.

segments.zh: 他的故事，是關於希望、失望，以及最終尋求新開始的旅程。
segments.en: His story is about hope, disappointment, and ultimately a journey to seek a new beginning.

segments.zh: 無論你支持哪一方，這都提醒我們移民議題的複雜性與人性考量。
segments.en: Regardless of your stance, it reminds us of the complexity and human considerations in immigration.

segments.zh: 最後一個故事，絕對會讓你大開眼界！印度政府被一位領袖痛批「失去方向」。
segments.en: Our last story will absolutely blow your mind! The Indian government was slammed for 'losing the plot'.

segments.zh: 這位領袖名叫索拉夫·達斯，他因為護照被標記，被禁止搭機前往英國。
segments.en: This leader, Saurav Das, was barred from a UK flight because his passport was flagged.

segments.zh: 更離譜的是，達斯先生自稱被政府官員私下稱為「蟑螂」！
segments.en: Even more outrageous, Mr. Das claims government officials privately called him a 'cockroach'!

segments.zh: 這稱號簡直是聞所未聞，讓 Reddit 網友們都炸鍋了！
segments.en: This nickname is simply unheard of, and Reddit users absolutely exploded!

segments.zh: 有人笑說：「難道他們以為他是害蟲，所以不能搭飛機嗎？」
segments.en: Someone joked, 'Did they think he was a pest, so he couldn't fly?'

segments.zh: 也有人憤怒地說：「這種言論，簡直是侮辱了整個民主！」
segments.en: Others furiously stated, 'Such rhetoric is an insult to democracy itself!'

segments.zh: 這起事件不僅暴露了印度政府的內部問題，也引發了對言論自由的熱烈討論。
segments.en: This incident exposes internal issues within the Indian government and sparks heated debate on free speech.

segments.zh: 誰能想到，一個看似荒謬的稱號，竟然能引發如此大的政治風波呢？
segments.en: Who would have thought such an absurd nickname could trigger such a huge political uproar?

segments.zh: 好了，今天的雙語精華就到這裡告一段落。
segments.en: Alright, that brings us to the end of today's bilingual highlights.

segments.zh: 從科技巨頭的政治糾葛，到移民的艱辛旅程，再到離譜的政治綽號。
segments.en: From tech giants' political entanglements to immigrants' tough journeys, and absurd political nicknames.

segments.zh: 希望這些精彩的故事，讓你的世界觀又多了一點點不一樣的色彩。
segments.en: I hope these exciting stories have added a little different color to your worldview.

segments.zh: 別忘了訂閱我們的頻道，下週同一時間，我們空中再見！
segments.en: Don't forget to subscribe to our channel, and we'll see you next week at the same time!
